recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, sepia-toned editorial portrait of a female artist centered against a blurred, atmospheric background. The subject wears a bold vertically striped blazer and dark briefs, positioned with a slight side-profile turn. The composition is framed by a heavy dark vignette and layered with elegant script and serif typography.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast vertical stripes against a soft, out-of-focus background
Large-scale script lettering overlapping the subject's lower body
Symmetrical placement of secondary text elements in the corners
Monochromatic sepia palette unifying diverse textures
coreInvariants: Mix of formal serif and fluid script fonts

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Full-body portrait centered vertically, occupying approximately 70% of the frame height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and the bold pattern of the striped blazer.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the face, moves down the striped jacket to the large script name, then circles to the corner metadata text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Substantial blurred space to the left and right of the subject, darkened by a vignette to focus attention inward.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm sepia mid-tones for the background and skin.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep charcoal/black for the vignette and jacket stripes.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Off-white/cream for the typography and highlights.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation (monochrome) with high value contrast between the white stripes and dark shadows.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of high-contrast transitional serifs and elegant, monolinear scripts.
letterConstructionRules: Display script features long, sweeping ascenders and descenders
Serif fonts use sharp, bracketed serifs and high stroke contrast
Metadata text uses wide tracking for a modern look
characterSpecificRedesigns: Script 'M' and 'K' have exaggerated, fluid tails that extend horizontally
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a formal, structured serif and a loose, handwritten script.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the fluid, elegant display lettering style.
Provides the high-contrast serif look for secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a sepia-toned studio portrait of a woman in a black and white vertically striped blazer, centered, with a heavily blurred dark background and a strong vignette.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, cream-colored script text across the lower third, overlapping the subject. Place smaller serif text in the top right and top left corners, and wide-tracked URL text at the very bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the image strictly monochromatic sepia?
Does the script text overlap the subject's legs?
Is the vignette strong enough to darken the corners significantly?

adjustableVariables: Depth of field in the background
mustRedesign: Specific artist names and social media handles

mustAchieve: Smooth tonal gradients in the background

postGenerationChecks: Check for consistent sepia grading across all elements.
Ensure the script font does not obscure critical facial features.
Verify that the striped pattern does not create moiré effects.
Confirm the vignette doesn't hide the subject's silhouette entirely.
recipe.reuseFormula: Editorial Portrait + Sepia Grade + Striped Pattern + Overlapping Script Typography + Heavy Vignette
